confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live listings. Restaurant and beer anchors are the more reliable; hotel and hostel anchors vary more by venue, season and booking channel. July is low season (rainy season), so estimates lean toward off-peak rates. Cocktail and wine are estimated from the local beer relationship because direct knowledge is weaker.
comparable_city_reasoning: Basis is Cambodian coastal and backpacker towns, adjusted from Phnom Penh and Siem Reap local-venue pricing, with reference to Thai and Vietnamese beach-town tourist pricing. US dollars are widely used for tourist prices.
